evidence: Source reads and edits only; no builds, tests, syntax checks, JNI/project/game execution, shader compilation, GPU calls, launch, attachment or process inspection

producer.selection: WorldFrame.geometry selects the same immutable live/recorded JavaEntityShader as software rendering, with archived camera/space checks during replay
producer.version: ARCGEO06 for supplied layer eligibility (java-layer-visibility-source.json); otherwise v5 logical texture identity or the existing v4/v3/v2/v1 selection.
producer.positionSpace: Material-bearing packets require a declared world or camera-relative coordinate space
producer.layout: After the optional equipment matrix and before actor count: strict u8 material presence, then 1058 little-endian f32 values when present
producer.scalarOrder: lightmap 1024 RGBA channels, ColorModulator 4, two light directions 6, fog-position affine transform 12, selected overlay texel 4, fog color 4, fog ranges 4
producer.bound: The existing 96 MiB packet budget includes the 4233-byte material extension

decoder.ownership: EntityMaterial arrays are Rust-owned, decoded with the frame; no engine object layout or native pointer is created
validation: existing frame/session/camera/geometry bounds and no trailing data
decoder.legacy: ARCGEO01 yields no material; no white lightmap, inferred fog or copied presentation state fills absence

nativeAssembly.input: Inputs.for_frame derives explicit material fields from the copied cohort and selects the matching body/equipment projection with the existing reverse-Z conversion
nativeAssembly.constants: Constants.from_frame preflights each nonempty batch's supported role, scene-light provenance, skin visibility and layer eligibility when applicable, tint, camera and shader encoding before allocating its owned upload resource
nativeAssembly.emptySubmits: The uniform-index vector retains one entry per source batch; empty submits have no constant slot and remain present in the order plan
nativeAssembly.identity: For material-bearing frames, draw preparation compares all 256 draw-constant bytes and all 4096 lightmap bytes against the copied cohort, in addition to existing kind/projection/tint checks
nativeAssembly.geometry: Geometry.from_uploaded validates caller-supplied feature groups, builds packet-derived constants and preflights their complete draw mapping; no commands are recorded or submitted by assembly
nativeAssembly.notSupplied: Feature-group object/equality identities, actual native target/descriptor ownership and the current feature phase still require their real owning adapter

remaining: Authoritative installed-game capture of Java-equivalent material/lightmap/packed-light inputs
Per-role/per-actor material cohorts when a scene does not share the explicit profile
Ghost/outline/dissolve skin and native glint material variants; explicit normal skin source support now uses batch-specific overlay inputs
Live feature-group producer, insertion caller and full scene lifetime joins; serialized geometry scheduling and completed upload handoff are now connected in native-geometry-stream-source.json
